hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin picked up his brush carefully. The small booklet he had spread out on the table was already packed with writing he had begun several days earlier.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin carefully picked up his brush. The small booklet spread across the table was already packed with entries from the past several days.

hunks.baseline: X Month X Day. The weather was a damn mess, then cleared up.
hunks.sol: X Month X Day. Weather was shitty, then cleared up.

hunks.baseline: I had a nightmare. It was about a monster that looked like a dragon. It was so frightening that I wet myself in my sleep.
hunks.sol: I had a nightmare about a monster that looked like a dragon. It scared me so badly I wet myself in my sleep.

hunks.baseline: As soon as I woke up, I secretly went to the stream to wash my undergarments and trousers, only to find Young Hero Gung already there, washing a pair of shit-stained trousers.
hunks.sol: As soon as I woke up, I sneaked down to the stream to wash my undergarments and trousers. Young Hero Gung was already there, washing shit out of his trousers.

hunks.baseline: What a filthy bastard. Even a beggar could be more respectable than him.
hunks.sol: What a filthy bastard. Even among beggars, you’d be hard-pressed to find a worse one.

hunks.baseline: According to Mungyeong, the monster was an imugi, and demonic qi had surged all the way into its marrow, driving it to commit an atrocity that outraged heaven and humanity.
hunks.sol: According to Mungyeong, the monster was an imugi. Demonic qi had seeped into its very marrow and driven it to commit an atrocity that outraged heaven and humanity.

hunks.baseline: Fortunately, thanks to the Captain stepping in, I was barely affected by the demonic qi. However, I was diagnosed with the need to keep writing in my diary and retracing my memories for the time being.
hunks.sol: Fortunately, thanks to the Captain stepping in, I was barely affected by the demonic qi. I was told to keep a diary for the time being and use it to piece my memories back together.

hunks.baseline: That aside, I couldn’t believe those ridiculous scenes had all been real.
hunks.sol: Still, I couldn’t believe all those ridiculous things I’d seen had actually happened.

hunks.baseline: While listening to Mungyeong, a question suddenly occurred to me. I asked whether that dream—no, whether the sight I had seen of him fighting there had also been real.
hunks.sol: While Mungyeong was explaining, a question occurred to me. I asked if what I’d seen in the dream—no, what I’d seen there, with him fighting—had been real too.

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong answered that it had not. Young Hero Gung joined me in questioning him, but for some reason, I fell asleep on the spot. I must have been tired.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong said no. Young Hero Gung joined in asking him about it, but for some reason, I fell asleep right there. I must have been tired.

hunks.baseline: But why do I have a bruise on my forehead?
hunks.sol: Then why is there a bruise on my forehead?

hunks.baseline: I don’t know. I should go back to sleep.
hunks.sol: I don’t know. I’m going back to sleep.

hunks.baseline: I went to dispose of the corpse. I shit myself once at the imugi’s enormous size, then a second time at the Captain’s butchering skills.
hunks.sol: I went to deal with the corpse. The imugi’s enormous size nearly made me piss myself once, and the Captain’s butchering skills nearly did it a second time.

hunks.baseline: I heard that the imugi’s corpse, divided into bones, scales, and flesh, would be transported in secret.
hunks.sol: I heard the imugi’s corpse would be transported in secret after being divided into bones, scales, and flesh.

hunks.baseline: Perfected Being Hyeongong, enraged, declared that he would find the culprit. But that was ridiculous. It wasn’t a fist-sized amount. Who could steal that much?
hunks.sol: Perfected Being Hyeongong was furious and declared that he would find the culprit, but that’s ridiculous. We’re not talking about something the size of a fist. Who could steal that much?

hunks.baseline: After leaving the minor commotion behind and boarding the boat back, I noticed a terrible smell of shit coming from somewhere.
hunks.sol: We left the little commotion behind and boarded the boat back. Once aboard, I noticed a terrible smell of shit coming from somewhere.

hunks.baseline: Unable to stand it any longer, I brought it up first. Before I could even finish speaking, the Captain pointed at Young Hero Gung.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t stand it any longer and brought it up. Before I could finish speaking, the Captain pointed at Young Hero Gung.

hunks.baseline: He vehemently denied it, but having witnessed him shit himself a few days ago, I couldn’t believe a word he said.
hunks.sol: He denied it vehemently, but I saw him washing his shit-stained trousers a few days ago. How could I believe him?

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong, sitting beside me, wore an odd expression the entire time.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong sat beside me with an odd expression the whole time.

hunks.baseline: He probably wanted to unload a bucketful of abuse because of the smell, but was holding back out of consideration for Young Hero Gung’s dignity.
hunks.sol: He probably wanted to curse Young Hero Gung out over the smell but held back to spare his dignity.

hunks.baseline: What a good kid. He’s so innocent and endearing every time I see him.
hunks.sol: What a good kid. Every time I see him, he seems so innocent and easy to like.

hunks.baseline: It has been two days since we disposed of the imugi’s corpse.
hunks.sol: It’s been two days since we dealt with the imugi’s corpse.

hunks.baseline: I don’t know what happened, but Sir Jeok has disappeared completely, and the Captain grows gaunter by the day.
hunks.sol: I don’t know why, but Sir Jeok hasn’t been around at all, and the Captain looks gaunter by the day.

hunks.baseline: I joked that he looked like someone being tormented by poison and ambushes day and night, and he glared at me as though he wanted to kill me.
hunks.sol: I joked that he looked like someone being tormented by poison and ambushes day and night. He glared at me as if he wanted to kill me.

hunks.baseline: He only makes a fuss at me because I look easy.
hunks.sol: He only takes it out on me because I’m an easy target.

hunks.baseline: Just as I was thinking that, Young Hero Gung said the same thing and I watched him get beaten. I felt better.
hunks.sol: Just as I was thinking that, Young Hero Gung said the same thing and got beaten too. I felt better.

hunks.baseline: This is the first time I’ve written in three days. The reason I neglected my diary was that there was nothing worth writing about.
hunks.sol: This is my first entry in three days. I haven’t written because there was nothing worth writing about.

hunks.baseline: After Sir Jeok, the Captain also became difficult to see, and Mungyeong has been wandering off somewhere or other, so he is rarely around too.
hunks.sol: First Sir Jeok, and now the Captain has become hard to find. Mungyeong keeps wandering off somewhere too.

hunks.baseline: What would a martial artist like me do with his free time? Young Hero Gung and I searched for a decent place and trained.
hunks.sol: What else is a martial artist like me supposed to do with his free time? Young Hero Gung and I found a decent place to train.

hunks.baseline: His breath smells like a sewer, but when he keeps his mouth shut during training, he’s not so bad.
hunks.sol: His breath smells like a sewer, but when he keeps his mouth shut and trains, he’s not so bad.

hunks.baseline: On the other hand, Young Hero Cheongpung’s advice, despite somehow finding us, was useless every time.
hunks.sol: Young Hero Cheongpung somehow found us. Every bit of advice he gave was useless.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps because he was frustrated, he demonstrated it for me, but I couldn’t understand a thing.
hunks.sol: Maybe he got frustrated, because he demonstrated it for me. I still couldn’t understand a thing.

hunks.baseline: Every time we trained, that water snake called something like Mimi swallowed Blood Fish beside us. Maybe because of that, he seems to have grown quite a bit. His horns have grown too.
hunks.sol: Every time we train, that water snake called something like Mimi sits beside us swallowing Blood Fish. Maybe that’s why it seems to have grown so much. Its horns too.

hunks.baseline: No wonder it seemed as though the Blood Fish had gone extinct. They must have all gone down that bastard’s throat.
hunks.sol: No wonder the Blood Fish seemed to have vanished. They must have all gone down that thing’s throat.

hunks.baseline: I’ve become fairly close with several martial artists from the Zhuge Clan and Wudang, and thanks to that, I heard some news.
hunks.sol: I’ve become fairly friendly with a few martial artists from the Zhuge Clan and Wudang, and they’ve told me some things.

hunks.baseline: The Zhuge Clan is testing a formation under the direct command of Sir Zhuge Feng, the Crouching Dragon Guest, apparently one that can completely seal the gap.
hunks.sol: Under the direct supervision of Sir Zhuge Feng, the Crouching Dragon Guest, the Zhuge Clan is testing a formation to seal the gap completely.

hunks.baseline: I hear that if they can’t block it, strange things like the Blood Fish will continue to appear. I have no idea what bizarre and unfathomable method those Dark Heaven bastards used to create them.
hunks.sol: Apparently, if they can’t seal it, strange creatures like the Blood Fish will keep appearing. I have no idea what bizarre method those Dark Heaven bastards used to make such a thing.

hunks.baseline: Meanwhile, Wudang is still tracking the Killing Ghost.
hunks.sol: Meanwhile, Wudang is still hunting the Killing Ghost.

hunks.baseline: Even with the authorities joining the search and turning Hubei Province upside down, they still haven’t found him. He must be an expert at running away.
hunks.sol: Even with the authorities helping them comb through Hubei Province, they haven’t found him. The bastard must have made an art of running away.

hunks.baseline: It has been seven days and nights since I came here. The Captain’s complexion was calm when I saw him again after so long.
hunks.sol: It’s been seven days and nights since we arrived. When I finally saw the Captain again, he looked at peace.

hunks.baseline: Before, he had been covered in injuries from whatever training he was doing alone, and his complexion had been pale or even bluish. He seems to have recovered now.
hunks.sol: Before, he’d been covered in wounds from whatever training he was doing alone, and his face was either pale or tinged blue. He seems to be better now.

hunks.baseline: Instead, his temper has grown sharper, and he moves like a ghost.
hunks.sol: His temper has grown sharper instead, and he walks like a ghost.

hunks.baseline: He gives off so little sign of his presence that he caught Young Hero Gung and me bad-mouthing him and beat us within an inch of our lives.
hunks.sol: He makes so little noise that Young Hero Gung and I got caught bad-mouthing him and beaten half to death.

hunks.baseline: No, seriously. How did he hear us from that distance?
hunks.sol: Seriously, how did he hear us from that far away?

hunks.baseline: Come to think of it, Mungyeong had a satisfied expression while I was being beaten…
hunks.sol: Come to think of it, Mungyeong looked pleased while I was getting beaten… I must have imagined it.

hunks.baseline: I must have imagined it.
That was as far as the diary recording everything he had seen and experienced over roughly ten days went.
hunks.sol: That was where the diary of what Hyuk Mujin had seen and experienced over roughly ten days ended.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin stared down at the small booklet and sank into thought. Just as he was about to draw the first stroke of a new entry, noisy shouts came from outside.
hunks.sol: He gazed down at the booklet, lost in thought. Just as he was about to put brush to paper for a new entry, excited shouts came from outside.

hunks.baseline: “It worked—it worked!”
hunks.sol: “It—it worked!”

hunks.baseline: “Not you—I did it! As expected, I’m a genius! Zhuge Wuhou!”
hunks.sol: “Not you! *I* did it! I knew I was a genius! Zhuge Wuhou!”

hunks.baseline: Screech! Blot!
hunks.sol: Slip! Splotch!

hunks.baseline: His concentration wavered, his hand slipped, and the brush shook.
hunks.sol: His concentration broke. His hand slipped, and the brush went astray.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin’s face twisted as he tried to write with the mindset of a great literary master.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin’s face contorted. So much for writing with the bearing of a great literary master.

hunks.baseline: A familiar voice slipped into his ear as he raged.
hunks.sol: A familiar voice reached him.

hunks.baseline: “The bastard you’re talking about sounds like Sir Zhuge Feng. Shall I pass along your words?”
hunks.sol: “I believe that bastard is Sir Zhuge Feng. Shall I tell him what you said?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin answered gruffly and put down his brush as Gung Gibang entered the tent without permission.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin put down his brush and gave Gung Gibang, who had entered the tent without permission, a curt look.

hunks.baseline: “But what on earth is going on outside?”
hunks.sol: “But what on earth is happening outside?”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “It looks like the Zhuge Clan succeeded in completely sealing the gap.”
hunks.sol: “Looks like the Zhuge Clan managed to seal the gap completely.”

hunks.baseline: “What else? Rocks?”
hunks.sol: “What else would they use? Rocks?”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, come on. Why couldn’t we block it with rocks?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, come on. Why *couldn’t* they use rocks?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s not a fundamental solution. And if it could have been handled that way, they would have sealed it long ago. Think before you speak.”
hunks.sol: “Because that wouldn’t solve the problem. And if rocks were enough, they’d have sealed it ages ago. Think before you speak.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, really? Do you shit yourself because you think too much?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, really? Is thinking too much why you shit yourself?”

hunks.baseline: “Pissing is better than shitting. Besides, Young Hero Gung did it twice. Last time, when we went to dispose of the imugi’s corpse…”
hunks.sol: “Pissing is better than shitting. Besides, you did it twice. The other time was when we went to deal with the imugi’s corpse…”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Ah, this is driving me crazy. I told you, that wasn’t me!”
hunks.sol: “This is driving me crazy. I told you, that wasn’t me!”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin clicked his tongue as Gung Gibang pounded his chest.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin clicked his tongue as Gung Gibang thumped his chest.

hunks.baseline: “You should know when to stop denying it.”
hunks.sol: “There’s only so much you can deny.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m telling you, it’s true!”
hunks.sol: “I’m telling you the truth!”

hunks.baseline: “If it wasn’t Young Hero Gung, then who was it? Hmm? Surely you don’t think Perfected Being Hyeongong did it?”
hunks.sol: “If it wasn’t you, then who was it? Huh? Are you saying Perfected Being Hyeongong shit himself?”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang suddenly stopped, his face going pale as he looked around.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk
preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: Only a few days earlier, he had been beaten half to death after having a similar conversation.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang broke off with a start and looked around. Only a few days ago, he’d been beaten after a similar conversation.

hunks.baseline: “He’s not here, right?”
hunks.sol: “He’s not here, is he?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin swallowed dryly as well.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin swallowed.

hunks.baseline: The Jin Taekyung he knew had a fiery personality. Whoever started the insults, he would happily beat both sides senseless.
hunks.sol: The Jin Taekyung he knew didn’t care who had started the insults. He’d happily beat everyone involved.

hunks.baseline: “How would I know? If you can sense the Captain’s presence, you’re already a Supreme Peak master. Or a ghost.”
hunks.sol: “How would I know? Anyone who can sense the Captain coming is already a Supreme Peak master. Or a ghost.”

hunks.baseline: The two of them looked around with every sense on high alert, then let out deep sighs of relief.
hunks.sol: They searched their surroundings with every sense on alert before finally letting out a breath.

hunks.baseline: Suddenly, the absurdity of their situation struck them. They had become afraid after saying only a few words.
hunks.sol: It was absurd. A few words exchanged, and here they were, watching their backs.

hunks.baseline: “How long are we going to live like this?”
hunks.sol: “How long do we have to live like this?”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “What if he undergoes Returned to Youth later?”
hunks.sol: “What if he undergoes Returned to Youth someday?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin nodded vigorously in agreement. He had watched Jin Taekyung since the days when he had been a delinquent, so he couldn’t help but sympathize.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin nodded vigorously. He’d known Jin Taekyung since his days as a delinquent; of course he understood.

hunks.baseline: “That’s true. And not just one of them—there are two.”
hunks.sol: “That’s true. And there are two of them, not just one.”

hunks.baseline: “Young Hero Cheongpung? Don’t even get me started. After seeing the Drunken Eight Immortals Fist only a few times, he started imitating it pretty closely. If my master found out, he’d try to kill me for leaking our sect’s secret art.”
hunks.sol: “Young Hero Cheongpung? Don’t even bring him up. He saw the Drunken Eight Immortals Fist a few times and started imitating it. If my master found out, he’d try to kill me for letting our sect’s secret art get out.”

hunks.baseline: “……I have a fairly good idea what you were just thinking, but keep your mouth shut forever. I’m really going to die.”
hunks.sol: “…I can guess what you’re thinking. Keep your mouth shut forever. I mean it. He’ll kill me.”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “You vile bastard.”
hunks.sol: “You rotten bastard.”

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang shook his head and suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang shook his head, then asked, “What’s your lord doing, anyway? I hardly see him.”

hunks.baseline: “But what is your liege doing? I haven’t seen him at all.”
“I wouldn’t know. He may be training, or he may not. Sometimes he stays in his tent all day.”
hunks.sol: “How would I know? He might be training. Might not. Some days he stays in his tent the whole time.”

hunks.baseline: “Sir Jin is always busy with one thing or another, and I haven’t seen Sir Jeok in a long time.”
hunks.sol: “Sir Jin’s always busy with one thing or another. But Sir Jeok’s been gone a long time too.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang had completely vanished after the first day he arrived.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang had vanished without a trace after their first day there.

hunks.baseline: Many people were curious about his whereabouts, but no one was worried about his safety.
hunks.sol: Plenty of people wondered where he was. None worried about his safety.

hunks.baseline: He was the Fire King. Those two words alone were proof enough.
hunks.sol: Fire King. Those two words were proof enough of what he could do.

hunks.baseline: “Who could possibly harm the Fire King?”
hunks.sol: “Who could harm the Fire King?”

hunks.baseline: “True. Even Dark Heaven wouldn’t dare. If they tried anything, three or four of their pillars would have been ripped out, and the surrounding area would already have been reduced to ashes.”
hunks.sol: “True. Even Dark Heaven wouldn’t stand a chance. If they tried anything, he’d rip out three or four of their pillars, and the whole area would be a wasteland by now.”

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang nodded in agreement and continued.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang nodded, then paused.

hunks.baseline: “Wait. Come to think of it, I haven’t seen Mungyeong around lately either.”
hunks.sol: “Come to think of it, I haven’t seen much of Mungyeong lately either.”

hunks.baseline: “Now that you mention it, neither have I. Whenever I see him, he’s with the Captain.”
hunks.sol: “Neither have I. Whenever I do see him, he’s with the Captain.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. I wonder if it has something to do with the injuries the Captain suffered while training…”
hunks.sol: “Yes. I figured it might be because the Captain got hurt while training…”

hunks.baseline: “Why?”
hunks.sol: “What?”

hunks.baseline: “Nothing. Something smells fishy.”
hunks.sol: “Nothing. I smell something.”

hunks.baseline: “Hyuk Mujin, you lunatic. That’s not what I mean. I’m saying there’s something going on between them.”
hunks.sol: “Hyuk Mujin, you lunatic. Not that. I mean there’s something going on between them.”

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang narrowed his brow, deep in thought.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang frowned in thought.

hunks.baseline: “Could what be?”
hunks.sol: “Could what?”

hunks.baseline: “You still don’t get it? Why those two have been together so often lately?”
hunks.sol: “You still don’t get it? Why have those two been together so often lately?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin’s expression grew strange.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: As he listened to Gung Gibang, something clicked.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin’s expression changed. Listening to Gung Gibang, he began to see what he meant.

hunks.baseline: “Then perhaps…”
hunks.sol: “Then maybe…”

hunks.baseline: “That’s exactly what you’re thinking.”
hunks.sol: “Exactly what you’re thinking.”

hunks.baseline: “Good heavens. How can this be?”
hunks.sol: “Good heavens.”

hunks.baseline: “If you think about it, it is strange. The Captain punches us whenever he gets bored, but he hasn’t used so much as a single act of violence against Mungyeong.”
hunks.sol: “It *is* strange, when you think about it. He throws punches at us whenever he feels like it, but he’s never once laid a hand on Mungyeong.”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “He barely curses at him anymore, either. And he was suspicious the last time we went to dispose of the imugi’s corpse.”
hunks.sol: “He hardly even curses at him anymore. And something was suspicious when we went to deal with the imugi’s corpse.”

hunks.baseline: “When Jin Taekyung disappeared, Mungyeong wasn’t there either.”
hunks.sol: “When Jin Taekyung disappeared, Mungyeong was gone too.”

hunks.baseline: “Exactly! The Beggars’ Sect’s future Sect Leader never disappoints!”
hunks.sol: “Exactly! As expected of the Beggars’ Sect’s future leader!”

hunks.baseline: “Then it’s certain. Mungyeong…”
hunks.sol: “That settles it. Mungyeong…”

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang’s face stiffened as he spoke.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang’s face went rigid.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, Mungyeong! How did you end up making such a terrible choice?”
hunks.sol: “Ah, Mungyeong! How could you make such a terrible choice?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin was genuinely heartbroken. The thought of ink named Jin Taekyung bleeding into Mungyeong, who was as white and clean as a blank sheet of paper, made his chest ache.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin was genuinely heartbroken. Mungyeong was like a clean white sheet of paper. The thought of Jin Taekyung’s ink soaking into it made his chest ache.

hunks.baseline: “What sin did that child commit?”
hunks.sol: “What did that child ever do to deserve this?”

hunks.baseline: “Alas, what a tragedy. I have no face to show the Divine Physician in Sichuan.”
hunks.sol: “What a tragedy. How can I face the Divine Physician in Sichuan?”

hunks.baseline: “Mungyeong, Mungyeong can’t do this! We can’t let him walk the same path as us!”
hunks.sol: “Not Mungyeong! We can’t let him go down the same path we did!”

hunks.baseline: “The water has already been spilled. Jin Taekyung is a Fiend. Now that Mungyeong has fallen into the hands of such an evil bastard, there’s nothing we can do.”
hunks.sol: “It’s too late. Jin Taekyung is a Fiend. Now that Mungyeong is in that evil bastard’s clutches, there’s nothing we can do.”

hunks.baseline: “Whew…”
hunks.sol: “Haa…”

hunks.baseline: The two of them let out sighs filled with simultaneous lament.
Thinking of Mungyeong, who must by now be fighting for his life under Jin Taekyung’s evil clutches, they felt their hearts grow heavy.
hunks.sol: They sighed together. The thought of Mungyeong fighting for his life under Jin Taekyung’s wicked hand weighed heavily on them both.

hunks.baseline: *Hang in there, Mungyeong. Please survive.*
hunks.sol: *Please survive, Mungyeong.*

hunks.baseline: Slash!
hunks.sol: Slice!

hunks.baseline: A current of wind grazed my neck.
hunks.sol: A gust of wind brushed my neck.

hunks.baseline: The pain was as cold as ice, then immediately flared hot. A bead of cold sweat ran down my forehead and dropped onto the ground with a soft tap.
hunks.sol: The pain was cold as ice, then burned hot. A drop of cold sweat ran down my forehead and fell to the ground.

hunks.baseline: Whoosh, tap!
hunks.sol: Swish, tap!

hunks.baseline: An answering voice came back—or rather, it was Sound Transmission.
hunks.sol: A voice answered—or rather, a Sound Transmission.

hunks.baseline: —That was the point.
hunks.sol: —It was meant to be.

hunks.baseline: “No, I’m not joking. I really almost died.”
hunks.sol: “No, I’m serious. I almost died.”

hunks.baseline: —That is welcome news.
hunks.sol: —Glad to hear it.

hunks.baseline: No matter how carefully I looked around, I couldn’t see him. There was only the Sound Transmission, impossible to locate.
hunks.sol: I looked all around, but I couldn’t see him. There was only that Sound Transmission, coming from nowhere I could pin down.

hunks.baseline: I took a deep breath and gripped the shaft of White Flame.
hunks.sol: I took a deep breath and tightened my grip on White Flame’s shaft.

hunks.baseline: Toward whoever was watching me from somewhere unseen, I muttered as though spitting the words out.
hunks.sol: To whoever was watching me from somewhere out of sight, I muttered through clenched teeth.

hunks.baseline: “This is so fucking shitty I can’t keep doing this.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t fucking do this anymore.”

hunks.baseline: In place of an answer, a blinding sword strike flew toward me.
hunks.sol: Instead of an answer, a blinding sword strike came flying at me.
